reason: Successfully tested agent message interaction and verified correct arithmetic response containing the number 4.
steps: Navigated to http://localhost:47891 - Page loaded successfully showing the Gamut agent management interface with sidebar containing two agents.
Found and clicked on "QA-20261015-160242-xjvt" agent in the sidebar (ref=e74) - Successfully navigated to the agent page, displaying the agent home screen.
Verified agent status is "idle" - Status indicator confirmed as "idle" at the top of the page (shown in ref=e200), meeting the requirement.
Typed message "Hello! What is 2+2?" in the message input field (ref=e229) - Message successfully entered into the input field.
Clicked Send button (ref=e394) - Message submitted successfully, creating a new chat session titled "Basic Arithmetic Question Check", agent status changed to "working".

Waited for agent response using activity indicator - Activity indicator disappeared after agent completed processing, indicating response was received (waited approximately 5-10 seconds, well within the 3-minute timeout).

Verified response mentions "4" and took screenshot - Agent responded with "2 + 2 = 4." clearly showing the correct answer containing "4". Screenshot saved as 02-response-with-4.png showing the complete conversation.
